findings.text: Player residuals are shrunk towards 0 although reference baseline B0 has no match-state or pressure term, so the pressure-sample mean residual is non-zero and low-volume players are pulled to the wrong centre (spec 6 rule 6, 13; notes D). Fix: set shrink target to the pooled mean pressure residual of other players (FULL_SAMPLE, descriptive; strictly prior for predictive use), keep 0 as a named sensitivity, add a synthetic test (all residuals +0.2, one-ball player approaches +0.2), and state that per-candidate baselines are the match-state control.

No rule for choosing the provisional pressure definition (spec 11.5): 'after reading the numbers' allows selection on exploratory scores and ignores multiplicity. Fix: selection may use only population-level quantities (deliveries, matches, innings, n_eff, eligible counts, cross-format and LOMO/prior reproducibility), never player scores or rankings; ties go to the larger population at the same q; ranking stability is reported not used; report total candidates examined.

Wickets-bin merge step 4 merges the adjacent pair with the smallest combined m anywhere, so non-deficient bins (e.g. {2},{1}) can merge before the deficient bin ({10}); over-merges and is ambiguous (spec 8). Fix: merge the bin with the smallest m with the adjacent bin giving the larger combined m (ties toward Wrem 1), repeat; add a synthetic test where only {10} is deficient and {2},{1} stay separate.

dls_state_reliable=true includes revised innings that ended short of the stated limit: 8 of 25 revised innings 1 end below the limit without all out (15410, 15546, 31707, 36208 COMPLETED, 41975, 46311, 46749, 50408), so Brem/RRR would be wrong in the sensitivity variant (spec 7.6, notes A). Fix: add innings_ended_short_of_stated_limit (legal balls < L, W < 10, dls_flag true; for innings 2 only when not completed by reaching the target), set dls_state_reliable=false when true, update the 48/2 counts, add a unit test.

RRR when Req <= 0 is defined two ways: spec 3 and 9 say NULL only when Brem=0 or no target; spec 7.2 and 4 say NULL or non-pressure. Fix: RRR_k is NULL when req_nonpositive_flag is true (12 rows seen) and say so in section 3.

OTHER_T20 treatment in the state table is unstated (30 matches, 60 innings; par cells exist only for IPL and T20I). Fix: keep state columns, set par, exp_remaining and rank_pct NULL, count as format_out_of_scope, exclude from all pressure populations.

Candidate family details open (spec 11): quantile context for family (a) not stated as per-format or pooled; the pair (-resource_ratio, phase=death) has no quantile in its phase condition although 'both conditions use the same q'. Fix: quantiles per competition_type x role with pooled as sensitivity; for the death pair the phase is the fixed label and only -resource_ratio uses q.

Availability matrix (spec 5.3) has no rows for resource_ratio, projected_surplus, bowl_rel_A, bowl_rel_B, bat_pressure_rel, bowl_B_early_flag. Fix: add one row each (pre-delivery yes, or PARTIAL with par_basis where par or rank cells are used).

Stage 5 and Stage 6 flows are specified only as 'reuse Phase 2.5' (spec 14, notes): eligibility candidate generation, feeding the exploratory score into the combination engine and ADJUSTED_ESTIMATE are not defined. Fix: add a short subsection naming the Phase 2.5 functions reused, their inputs, and the rule that a missing format score stays missing.
